definition: feeling very ashamed and sad because you know you have done something wrong (guilty about + something)
translation: cảm thấy có lỗi về điều gì
exampleSentence: I feel really guilty about forgetting her birthday again.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy rất có lỗi vì lại quên sinh nhật cô ấy.

definition: having done something that is a crime (guilty of + something)
exampleSentence: The jury found her guilty of murder.
exampleTranslation: Bồi thẩm đoàn kết luận cô ta phạm tội giết người.

definition: having feelings of pleasure because something good has happened (happy about + something)
exampleSentence: She's very happy about the baby.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy rất vui về đứa bé.

definition: pleased because something good has happened to someone (happy for + somebody)
exampleSentence: What a wonderful opportunity! I'm so happy for you.
exampleTranslation: Thật là một cơ hội tuyệt vời! Tôi mừng cho bạn lắm.

definition: satisfied or not worried about something (happy with + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: On the whole, I'm happy with the way I look.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn chung, tôi hài lòng với ngoại hình của mình.

definition: very bad at something; informal and especially British English (hopeless at + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: My brother was always pretty hopeless at ball games.
exampleTranslation: Anh trai tôi lúc nào cũng khá tệ ở các môn bóng.

definition: feeling admiration and respect for someone or something (impressed by + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: We were very impressed by the standard of work.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi rất ấn tượng với chất lượng công việc.

definition: giving a lot of attention to something because you want to know more about it (interested in + something/-ing)
translation: quan tâm đến, hứng thú với
exampleSentence: I've always been interested in music.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn quan tâm đến âm nhạc.

definition: taking part in an activity or event, or connected with it in some way (involved in + something)
translation: tham gia vào, dính líu đến
exampleSentence: More than 30 software firms were involved in the project.
exampleTranslation: Hơn 30 công ty phần mềm đã tham gia dự án.

definition: taking part in an activity or connected with something or someone (involved with + something/somebody)
translation: có liên quan, gắn bó với
exampleSentence: Landel has been involved with the Hercules project for years.
exampleTranslation: Landel đã gắn bó với dự án Hercules nhiều năm.

definition: unhappy because someone has something that you wish you had (jealous of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Why are you so jealous of his success?
exampleTranslation: Sao bạn lại ghen tị với thành công của anh ấy đến thế?

definition: very interested in something or enjoying it; especially British English (keen on + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Daniel is very keen on tennis.
exampleTranslation: Daniel rất mê quần vợt.

definition: saying or doing things that show you care about other people (kind to + somebody)
exampleSentence: They've been very kind to me.
exampleTranslation: Họ đã rất tốt với tôi.

definition: arriving or happening after the expected time (late for + something)
exampleSentence: Cheryl was late for school.
exampleTranslation: Cheryl đến trường muộn.

definition: having a husband or a wife (married to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Nicole is married to my brother.
exampleTranslation: Nicole kết hôn với anh trai tôi.

definition: worried or frightened about something and unable to relax (nervous about + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She was so nervous about her exams that she couldn't sleep.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy lo lắng về kỳ thi đến mức không ngủ được.

definition: friendly, kind or polite towards someone (nice to + somebody)
exampleSentence: They were very nice to me while I was ill.
exampleTranslation: Họ rất tốt với tôi khi tôi ốm.

definition: thinking or worrying about someone or something all the time (obsessed with + somebody/something)
translation: ám ảnh bởi, bị ám ảnh với
exampleSentence: Jody has been obsessed with some lifeguard for months.
exampleTranslation: Jody đã bị ám ảnh bởi một nhân viên cứu hộ suốt mấy tháng.

definition: disagreeing with something such as a plan or system (opposed to + something)
exampleSentence: Most of us are opposed to the death penalty.
exampleTranslation: Hầu hết chúng tôi phản đối án tử hình.

definition: happy or satisfied about something (pleased about + something)
exampleSentence: I could tell they were pleased about the news.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhận ra họ rất hài lòng về tin này.

definition: happy or satisfied with someone or something (pleased with + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Gwinn was pleased with the results.
exampleTranslation: Gwinn hài lòng với kết quả.

definition: liked by a lot of people (popular with + somebody)
translation: được yêu thích bởi, được ưa chuộng
exampleSentence: The president is very popular with young voters.
exampleTranslation: Tổng thống rất được cử tri trẻ yêu thích.

definition: feeling pleased about something you have done or something connected with you (proud of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Her parents are very proud of her.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ cô ấy rất tự hào về cô.

definition: prepared for what you are going to do (ready for + something)
exampleSentence: I don't feel that I'm ready for my driving test yet.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chưa thấy mình sẵn sàng cho kỳ thi lái xe.

definition: connected in some way to something or someone (related to + somebody/something)
translation: liên quan đến, có họ với
exampleSentence: He suffers from memory loss related to his illness.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy bị mất trí nhớ có liên quan đến bệnh của mình.

definition: directly connected with the subject or problem being discussed (relevant to + something)
exampleSentence: What experience do you have that is relevant to this position?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có kinh nghiệm nào liên quan đến vị trí này?

definition: being the cause of something bad, or being in charge of something (responsible for + something)
exampleSentence: Police believe the same man is responsible for three other murders.
exampleTranslation: Cảnh sát tin rằng cùng một người đã gây ra ba vụ giết người khác.

definition: speaking or behaving in a way that is not polite (rude to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Why are you so rude to her?
exampleTranslation: Sao bạn lại thô lỗ với cô ấy thế?

definition: not in danger of being harmed, lost or stolen (safe from + something)
exampleSentence: The birds' nests are high up, safe from predators.
exampleTranslation: Tổ chim nằm trên cao, an toàn khỏi kẻ săn mồi.

definition: feeling that something is as good as it should be (satisfied with + something)
exampleSentence: I'm not satisfied with the way he cut my hair.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không hài lòng với cách anh ấy cắt tóc cho tôi.

definition: frightened of something, or nervous about it (scared of + somebody/something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I've always been scared of dogs.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn sợ chó.

definition: really meaning what you say or plan to do (serious about + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Is she serious about giving up her job?
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy có nghiêm túc về việc bỏ việc không?

definition: feeling surprised and upset by something unexpected and unpleasant (shocked at + something)
exampleSentence: He is shocked at what happened to his son.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy sốc trước những gì đã xảy ra với con trai mình.

definition: feeling surprised and upset because of something unexpected and unpleasant (shocked by + something)
exampleSentence: I was deeply shocked by Jo's death.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sốc nặng trước cái chết của Jo.

definition: not having enough of something (short of + something)
exampleSentence: Our libraries are short of funds.
exampleTranslation: Các thư viện của chúng tôi thiếu kinh phí.

definition: angry or bored with something that has been happening for a long time; spoken (sick of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I am sick of working for other people.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chán ngấy việc làm thuê cho người khác.

definition: almost the same as something or someone (similar to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Her ideas are quite similar to mine.
exampleTranslation: Ý tưởng của cô ấy khá giống ý tưởng của tôi.

definition: feeling sad about a situation and wishing it were different (sorry about + something)
translation: buồn về, tiếc về điều gì
exampleSentence: I'm so sorry about your father.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất tiếc về chuyện của bố bạn.

definition: feeling ashamed or unhappy about something bad you have done (sorry for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She was genuinely sorry for what she had done.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thật lòng hối hận vì những gì mình đã làm.

definition: confident that you know something or that something is true (sure about + something)
exampleSentence: Are you sure about that?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có chắc về điều đó không?

definition: confident that you know something or that something is true (sure of + something)
exampleSentence: He wasn't even sure of his mother's name.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy thậm chí không chắc tên mẹ mình.

definition: having a feeling of surprise because of something (surprised at + something)
exampleSentence: We were greatly surprised at the news.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi vô cùng ngạc nhiên trước tin này.

definition: having a feeling of surprise because of something (surprised by + something)
exampleSentence: He was a little surprised by her request.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hơi ngạc nhiên trước yêu cầu của cô ấy.

definition: thinking that someone might be guilty of something wrong (suspicious of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Some of his colleagues became suspicious of his behaviour.
exampleTranslation: Một số đồng nghiệp bắt đầu nghi ngờ hành vi của anh ấy.

definition: caring about and feeling sorry for someone's problems, or agreeing with an idea (sympathetic to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I'm sympathetic to parents who worry about what their children see online.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cảm thông với các bậc cha mẹ lo lắng về những gì con mình xem trên mạng.

definition: bored with something because it is no longer interesting (tired of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I'm tired of watching television; let's go for a walk.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chán xem tivi rồi; mình đi dạo đi.

definition: having the usual features of a particular group or kind (typical of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: This painting is typical of his work.
exampleTranslation: Bức tranh này điển hình cho tác phẩm của ông ấy.

definition: unhappy and worried because something unpleasant has happened (upset about + something)
exampleSentence: She was deeply upset about the way her father treated her.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy rất buồn về cách bố đối xử với mình.

definition: angry and annoyed with someone (upset with + somebody)
exampleSentence: You're not still upset with me, are you?
exampleTranslation: Bạn vẫn chưa hết giận tôi, đúng không?

definition: helping you to do or get what you want (useful for + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: The space under the desk is useful for storing CDs.
exampleTranslation: Khoảng trống dưới bàn hữu ích để cất đĩa CD.
